bio.text: Kailee Buller is the Republican candidate for New York's 22nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election; NBC News listed her as the winner of the uncontested June 23, 2026 Republican primary, and CNYCentral reported she faces Democratic incumbent John Mannion.

She is a native of Auburn who most recently served as chief of staff to Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins, and has been president and CEO of the National Oilseed Processors Association and the Edible Oil Producers Association.
CNYCentral reported that she graduated from the University at Buffalo in 2011 and moved to Washington, D.C., shortly afterward to work at a nonprofit.
